name: farahinani-portfolio
description: farahinani.com — plain HTML/CSS/JS portfolio, no build step
author: farahinani <farahinani27@gmail.com>

scripts.update:gsap: npm install gsap@3 && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['gsap.min.js','ScrollTrigger.min.js'])fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/gsap/dist/'+f,'assets/js/vendor/'+f);console.log('vendored gsap',require('gsap/package.json').version)"

comments.no-build: There is no bundler. GSAP is vendored into assets/js/vendor/ and committed. npm is only needed to refresh it (update:gsap) or regenerate images (build:images).
comments.images: Responsive image variants in assets/img/ are generated with scripts/build-images.mjs (needs the dev dependency 'sharp'). Source photos are NOT committed.
comments.local-dev: Use the VS Code Live Server extension, or `npm run serve`.
